text.tspan: Logic. MC-38 NO is open while its magnet is near.
All caps OFF: all 3 reeds closed, switch closed, PS_ON tied to GND, PSU on.
ANY cap fitted: that reed opens, loop broken, PSU cannot start (and shuts down if a cap is fitted while running).
Check each reed's contact state with a multimeter before wiring; a welded-closed reed defeats it,
so keep the visible REMOVE BEFORE POWER-ON tag.
